features: 4K HD IMAGE QUALITY: Digitek DAC-103 Action Thumbs Camera supports 5K HD image quality for capturing detailed photos and videos in a compact, portable design.
WIDE-ANGLE LENS: Equipped with a 140° wide-angle FOV, this mini action camera captures a broader perspective, making it suitable for travel, outdoor activities, vlogging and everyday recording.
BUILT-IN LCD DISPLAY: Features a 1.5-inch LCD screen for convenient framing, previewing and reviewing your captured content directly on the camera.

WI-FI & MOBILE CONNECTIVITY: Supports 2.4G wireless connectivity and the Hiicam app for Android and iOS, allowing convenient mobile connectivity. Video is recorded in MP4 format and photos in JPG format.

COMPACT & EXPANDABLE STORAGE: Features a 650mAh battery, Type-C charging port and support for up to 256GB storage via Micro SD card. The 35g lightweight body includes a waterproof housing, protective frame, magnetic pendant mount and hook-and-loop strap.
